subject: english
prompt: Read the email: 'To: Club members / The meeting has moved from Room 201 to Room 305. It will still begin at 3:00 p.m.' Which detail stayed the same?

options.text: The date of the next holiday.

answer.explanation: The email says the room changed but explicitly keeps the 3:00 p.m. starting time, so B stayed the same.

solutionStrategy: 抓住 from...to... 判斷改變項，再找 still 所標示的未變條件。
solutionSteps: 先把 Room 201 和 Room 305 標成同一項目的舊值與新值。
找到 still begin at 3:00 p.m.，注意 still 表示維持不變。
比較四個選項，只有 starting time 對應 3:00 p.m.。
排除 room number，因為它正是由 201 改成 305 的項目。
選 B，回讀確認題目問 stayed the same 而不是 changed。
